name: Hildred
source:
This is a story about a woman and her cartoon dog... Can one's idyllic life be achieved when there is no screen or borders between you and your creation?

[From [url=https://roseofrevolt.itch.io/hildred]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于一个女人和她的卡通狗的故事……当你和你的创作之间没有屏幕和边界时，一个人的田园生活还能实现吗？

[来自[url=https://roseofrevolt.itch.io/hildred]itch.io[/url]]
